What happens after you publish

1 — The hook lands

Within the first day, your headline and opening question are live. Bounces go first — the first sign it's working.

2 — Answers start flowing

Around day 3, completions build as the question flow keeps visitors moving to the offer.

3 — The offer lands warm

By week 1, visitors reach your offer already pre-sold by the answers they gave. Small leaks close at this stage.

4 — Converting on autopilot

By weeks 2–4, even cold traffic starts converting. Just a funnel you won't think twice about scaling.
